work.description: The act raises Offida in Piceno to the rank of a city. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF12095; own dating clause LF12226–12229 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima decembris mil- lesimo octingentesimo trigesimo prima, pon- tificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF12179 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
